en.value: Japanese writer, playwright, photographer and inventor

value.text: In that same year Suna no onna (The Woman in the Dunes), Abe’s most popular (and probably his best) novel, was published to general acclaim. It was made into an internationally successful film in 1964.

datavalue.value: 公房 きみふさ, Kimifusa, Kimihusa, こうぼう, Kōbō, Kôbô, Kobo, Koubou 安部 aka あべ, Abe (7 Mar 1924 - 22 Jan 1993)
